snippet.title: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts NOW AVAILABLE | DLC 4 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
NOW AVAILABLE!
Heed the Concepts, play RISK OF RAIN 2: Hallowed Concepts now: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts on Steam
 
Heed the Concepts.
One must withstand suffering to learn true balance.
Delve deeper into the dark, cult-like world of N'kuhana in Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts.
 
Fight through unexplored regions of Petrichor V with two new playable survivors:
Acolyte dances across the battlefield, toying with her enemies and bargaining for more power with her own life force.
Combine close range glaive attacks with ranged strikes that chip away at an enemy's soul.
Fight well, and Ascend.
 
Enforcer holds the line or drives it forward with dynamic, tactical movement. 
Create cover as a defensive vanguard, or dive straight into the heart of the action and decimate your enemies where they stand.
 
Endure harrowing Trials, face new enemies, and uncover powers never before possible.

Join the Community: https://discord.com/invite/riskofrain2
Follow Risk of Rain on Social Media!
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@riskofraingame
